name: Professor Marguerite Quill
tagline: Mathematics professor. Will calculate your odds out loud, whether you asked or not.
bio: Professor Quill teaches probability at a small college and treats every card game as a fascinating lecture. She is brilliant, scatterbrained, and constantly losing her glasses, which are almost always on top of her head. Prone to delightful tangents about the history of playing cards.
look: Woman in her mid 50s, wild curly auburn hair streaked with gray, two pairs of glasses (one on her nose, one forgotten on top of her head), tweed blazer, chalk dust on her sleeve, a pencil stuck in her hair. Default expression: thoughtful, slightly distracted.

voice.description: Clear, articulate middle-aged female voice; quick and enthusiastic, slightly breathless when excited.

game.start.text: Splendid! Fifty-two cards. The possibilities are astronomical. Literally.
Has anyone seen my glasses? ...Oh. They're on my head. Let's begin.
Fun fact: there are more ways to shuffle a deck than atoms on Earth. Anyway, deal!

game.won.self.text: Victory! Statistically, it was bound to happen eventually.
Ha! The math works! I'll be mentioning this in Monday's lecture.

game.won.human.text: Remarkable! You'd make a fine statistician.
Well played! I shall have to revise my model of you.

game.won.other.text: Well done. My calculations suggest I was distracted.

hand.good.self.text: Excellent. Exactly as the probabilities predicted. Roughly.

hand.bad.self.text: Hmm. That outcome was improbable. Yet here we are.
I must have carried a one somewhere.

hand.good.human.text: Well reasoned! I'd give that an A.

hand.bad.human.text: Variance, my dear. Pure variance. Don't take it personally.

idle.human.text: Take your time. Did you know playing cards came to Europe in the 1370s? Anyway, no rush.
Thinking deeply, I see. I approve.

hearts.queen_taken.self.text: Ah. I estimated a twelve percent chance of that. Rounding error.
The Queen of Spades. Historically quite unlucky. Personally, also.

hearts.queen_taken.human.text: Oh dear. The odds were in your favor, I promise.

hearts.queen_taken.other.text: Fascinating. I had a hunch she was hiding there.

hearts.queen_given.self.text: And the Queen finds a new home. Probability is so satisfying.
As predicted. I'd show my work, but it's on my other glasses.

hearts.hearts_broken.self.text: Hearts are broken. A necessary inflection point.

hearts.hearts_broken.other.text: Ah, and the hearts are broken. The game enters its second phase.

hearts.jack_taken.self.text: The Jack of Diamonds! A negative number has never looked so lovely.

hearts.jack_taken.human.text: Well spotted! That Jack is worth a good deal.

hearts.moon_shot.self.text: I shot the moon! Somebody fetch my chalkboard!
Twenty-six points to everyone else. The math is beautiful.

hearts.moon_shot.human.text: You shot the moon! The odds of that are... well, quite small! Bravo!
Extraordinary! I must write a paper about this.

hearts.moon_shot.other.text: A moon shot! How statistically delightful.

hearts.moon_blocked.self.text: Blocked by a single card. How very improbable. How very annoying.

hearts.moon_blocked.human.text: So close! You were one card from glory.

hearts.moon_block.self.text: I saw that coming three tricks ago. I simply forgot to mention it.

hearts.pass.received.text: Interesting choices. I'm analyzing your motives.
Hmm. These tell me a great deal about your hand.

spades.bid_nil.self.text: Nil. By my calculations, I hold nothing of value. Rather like my desk.
I'll bid nil. The probability is favorable. Roughly.

spades.bid_nil.partner.text: Nil! Splendid. I shall endeavor to win everything else.
A nil! Fascinating. I'll keep the high cards busy.

spades.nil_made.self.text: Zero tricks! Exactly as predicted. Within error bars.
A successful nil. I'll be writing a paper.

spades.nil_made.partner.text: Bravo! A flawless nil. I'd give that an A-plus.

spades.nil_failed.self.text: Ah. I appear to have taken a trick. How improbable.
There goes my nil. I blame my glasses. Where are they?

spades.nil_failed.partner.text: Don't fret. Variance, my dear. Pure variance.
Unlucky, partner. The math was sound.

spades.nil_failed.opponent.text: Their nil has failed. I did calculate that.
Ah, a broken nil. Rather elegant, from here.

spades.set.us.text: We were set. I must have carried a one somewhere.
Hmm. Our bid exceeded our evidence.

spades.set.them.text: You were set. A useful lesson in overconfidence.

spades.bags.us.text: A bag penalty. Too many tricks. An embarrassment of riches.
Ten bags! I was counting. Just the wrong thing.

spades.bags.them.text: Ten bags. Compound interest catches everyone.

spades.trumped.self.text: A spade! Trump is simply applied probability.
Ruffed! Oh, I do love that word.

gin.gin.self.text: Gin! Ten cards, zero deadwood. Mathematically delicious.
Gin! The probability was low, but never zero.

gin.gin.human.text: Gin! Remarkable. I must revise my estimates.
Gin. Fascinating. Has anyone seen my glasses? I want a closer look.

gin.knock.self.text: I shall knock. The expected value is favorable.
Knocking now. Waiting longer would be statistically unwise.

gin.knock.human.text: A knock! Let us examine the evidence.
Knocking already? Your confidence interval must be narrow.

gin.undercut.self.text: Undercut! The data were on my side.
Ah, an undercut. Low cards, high satisfaction.

gin.undercut.human.text: Undercut. My model had a flaw. It was me.
Oh dear. I carried a one somewhere. Several, apparently.

gin.dead_hand.text: A dead hand. Statistically, it was bound to happen.
No result. A perfectly valid null hypothesis.

gin.took_discard.human.text: You took my discard. Noted. Carefully noted.
Interesting. That tells me something about your hand.

rummy.went_out.self.text: I'm out! The proof is complete.

rummy.went_out.human.text: You're out? I hadn't finished my calculations.
Well done. My estimate of your hand was quite wrong.

rummy.caught.self.text: Caught. I was optimizing for the long run. It ended early.
All these points. I held too many variables.

rummy.caught.human.text: Caught with points in hand. A classic sampling error.
Oh dear, that is a heavy hand. Statistically speaking.

rummy.took_pile.self.text: I'll take the whole pile. More data is always better.
All of it, please. A larger sample size.

rummy.took_pile.human.text: The entire pile! A bold experimental design.
That's a great many cards. I do hope you have a plan.

rummy.layoff.human.text: You've extended my meld. A collaborative paper, of sorts.
Building on my work. Do cite me.

rummy.big_meld.self.text: A splendid meld. Elegant, like a good equation.
Look at that sequence! Arithmetic at its finest.

rummy.big_meld.human.text: What a meld! I'd like to publish that.

poker.won_pot.self.text: Ah. The expected value finally arrived.
A win! I'd celebrate, but I can't find my glasses.

poker.won_pot.human.text: Well played. Your odds were excellent.
Splendid. I shall update my estimates of you.

poker.big_pot.self.text: A sizable pot! Wait, are my glasses in it?
Fascinating. The law of large numbers, in my favor.

poker.big_pot.human.text: What a pot! You'd make a fine statistician.
Remarkable. The math was clearly on your side.

poker.bluff.self.text: I had nothing. A calculated risk, you see.
A bluff! Game theory says I should do that sometimes.

poker.stood_pat.self.text: I shall keep all five. The probabilities are agreeable.
No cards, thank you. I've done the arithmetic.

poker.stood_pat.human.text: Standing pat? That narrows your range considerably.
No cards. How very informative of you.

poker.raise.human.text: A raise. Let me reconsider my priors.

poker.fold.self.text: I fold. The odds were simply dreadful.
Not worth it. I've checked twice.

poker.bad_beat.self.text: That was a one in twenty outcome. How rude.
Three of a kind, beaten. I need to lie down.

poker.bad_beat.human.text: Oh, that was improbable. I'm so sorry.
A terrible beat. The math was with you, at least.

poker.big_hand.self.text: A full house! Roughly one in seven hundred!
Look at that. Combinatorics at its finest.

poker.big_hand.human.text: My word! Do you know the odds of that?
Extraordinary! I must write that down. Where's my pen?

poker.busted.self.text: Out of chips. My model needs revision.
Busted. I'll be in my office, recalculating.

poker.busted.human.text: Out? Variance is cruel. You'll recover.
That happens, dear. Even with perfect math.

poker.sit_down.self.text: May I join? I've brought my calculator. And my glasses. Somewhere.
Hello! Has anyone seen my glasses? Oh. Head. Thank you.
